study type: Case-control study (with Mendelian randomization and functional validation)
exposure: METAP1 (methionyl aminopeptidase 1) expression in venous endothelial cells
METAP1 overexpression/knockdown in human umbilical vein endothelial cells
outcome: Expression of preeclampsia-related genes (VEGFA, FLT1, INHBA, IL1B)
cohort: The study included 17 postpartum patients with severe preeclampsia and 7 postpartum patients with normotensive pregnancy, from whom venous endothelial cells were isolated.
finding: The study found greater METAP1 expression in venous ECs of postpartum women with preeclampsia, which was supported by Mendelian randomization showing a causal link between higher vascular METAP1 expression and increased preeclampsia risk, and functional experiments demonstrating antiangiogenic and proinflammatory effects of METAP1.
